name: Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter
source:
Follow Emile Mayer, owner of A Slice of Comfort bakery in the Kingdom of Selias, when the Fae Kingdom's royal procession brings an interesting newcomer into his life.

[Edited from [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/bread-aflutter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
